assessment: The manuscript nicely advances our understanding of the roles of heterochronic genes and the NHR-23 nuclear receptor transcription factor in the regulation of the temporal dynamics of molting behavior in C. elegans larval development. The data reveals direct regulatory feedback between let-7 family microRNAs and nhr-23, and shows that this circuit contributes to the regulation of developmental pace. The findings should be of interest to the field studying heterochronic genes and microRNAs in developmental timing, and to the broader field of chronobiology, particularly the regulation of complex oscillatory gene regulatory networks.
